headline: Sinarmas Companies Abandoned by the Widjaja Family This Year
summary: A reshuffle of management at Sinarmas Group has affected several of its companies this year, with the Widjaja family leaving their posts.
why: Sinarmas is a large Indonesian conglomerate with listed units in paper, property and finance, so governance changes can affect investor perception of its companies.
original_headline: Deretan Emiten Sinarmas yang Ditinggal Keluarga Widjaja Tahun Ini
